notes.subject: זמיר עריצים יענה
notes.rationale: KJV 'the branch of the terrible ones' (reading זמיר as branch); most read 'the song of the ruthless shall be brought low', and ענה as 'answer/humble'.

notes.subject: בציון
notes.rationale: Pointed 'in a dry place' (ציון II); consonants also allow 'in Zion', a wordplay lost in rendering.

notes.subject: חרב/כחרב
notes.rationale: Heat/drought word repeated, framing the verse; repetition not fully carried over.

notes.subject: זמיר
notes.rationale: Lemma of song-with-instruments; here rare, feeding the branch/song crux.
